description_full: PriceSmart, Inc. owns and operates membership shopping warehouse clubs in the United States, Central America, the Caribbean, and Colombia. The company offers basic consumable merchandise, as well as private label merchandise and consumable and non-consumable products under the Members Selection brand. Its products include groceries, cleaning supplies, and health and beauty aid; meat, produce, deli, seafood, and poultry; electronics, large and small appliances, automotive, hardware, sporting goods, and seasonal products; and clothing, domestics, and home furnishing products. The company also provides food service and bakery; and health services, including optical, audiology, and pharmacy. It sells its products through in-club shopping, mobile app, and online at PriceSmart.com that offers home delivery and curbside pickup under the Click & Go brand service. PriceSmart, Inc. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.

financial_summary: PriceSmart, Inc. is a mid-cap consumer defensive business with a $5.1B market cap on $5.9B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +10% over the past three years and +7% annually across the full decade, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 13% against a 8% cost of capital, a 5-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it.

The business throws off $96M in free cash flow — roughly 2 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.85× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 16× is fortress-like.
Shareholder yield is only 1.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 7.4% of the shares.
